name: Parallel Harmony ~Getsuyou no Tobira wa Suiyou no Mukou ni~
original_name: Parallel Harmony ～月曜の扉は水曜の向こうに～
source:
Main character opens some strange door and appears at a girls school similar to Meiji era. The inhabitants are living spirits of fox and cats. Every time he tries to confess, his juniors get in the way. Will he ever be able to convey his feelings freely?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公打开一扇奇怪的门，来到一所风格近似明治时代的女子学校。这里的居民是狐狸与猫的生灵。每当他试图告白，学妹们总会前来妨碍。他究竟能否顺利传达自己的心意？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
